# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 24 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches & Sales Activity

- **Lentor Gardens Residences sells 270 units at S$2,350 psf on launch day** - Kingsford Group reported a 54% take-up rate on 18 July 2026, with 270 of 499 units sold at an average of S$2,350 psf. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/lentor-gardens-residences-sells-270-units-at-an-average-of-s2350-psf/)

- **Dunearn House is the first private residential launch in the new Turf City precinct** - Indicative prices start from S$2,799 psf, with 380 units ranging from S$1.475 million (2-bedroom) to S$3.588 million (4-bedroom). [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/price-analysis-evaluating-dunearn-house-within-the-wider-bukit-timah-and-ccr/)

- **October 2026 BTO launch to offer 7,970 flats across seven projects** - Sites include two Bayshore locations near Bayshore MRT, a likely Prime-classified project in Toa Payoh, and Tengah's first BTO launch in three years. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/we-review-the-october-2026-bto-launch-sites/)

## Land & En-Bloc Deals

- **Bayshore Drive GLS site awarded to Frasers-led consortium at S$1,323 psf ppr** - URA awarded the tender on 20 July 2026 to Gemini Residential Pte. Ltd. and Gemini Trustee Pte. Ltd., following three bids when the tender closed on 15 July 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bayshore-drive-gls-1280-homes-integrated-mrt/)

- **Tan Boon Liat Building sold for S$950 million in what is likely Singapore's biggest en-bloc deal of 2026** - The buyer is Kingsford Havelock Pte Ltd; the freehold Outram Road site carries a raised Gross Plot Ratio of 4.9, allowing twin towers of up to 48 storeys. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapores-tan-boon-liat-building-sold-for-950m/)

## Resale & Market Records

- **District 5 resale capital gains record set at S$5.4 million** - A 4-bedroom unit at The Peak on Pepys Road beside Kent Ridge Park sold for S$8.5 million in early July 2026, generating the highest recorded resale profit in the district. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/d5-boutique-condo-sets-district-resale-profit-record-at-s5-4-million/)
